Priya (CS Ops): heads up — noticed a gap in owner propagation after the nightly CRM hygiene run. playbook triggers aren't seeing the new owner_id for a subset of accounts (mostly ones created in last 60d). :rotating_light:
Omar (Platform): can you paste the job id and a sample account id? is this the batch that uses owner-claimflow-v2?
Priya (CS Ops): job=crm-hygiene-2024-11-25-03, sample account=acct_8f3c. Quick repro: we run bulk update `UPDATE accounts SET owner_id = 'u_54' WHERE id IN (...)` then playbook webhook consumer shows no owner-change event for acct_8f3c.
Priya (CS Ops): log snippet:```
[2024-11-25T03:12:05Z] batch-runner INFO updated acct_8f3c owner->u_54
[2024-11-25T03:12:06Z] webhook-dispatcher WARN enqueue failed for acct_8f3c status=202 body=""
[2024-11-25T03:12:06Z] webhook-consumer ERROR processing acct_8f3c error=409-conflict msg="owner mismatch after enqueue"
```
Jules (Onboarding): FYI that's blocking onboarding flows for 3 trials (see https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-332, CS-333). Customers get "pending owner" screen and can't complete enablement checklist.
Ben (CS Manager): short term: can CS claim manually for the 3 trials? long term we need a rollback path and a fix to ensure playbook triggers on owner updates. Suggested mitigation: pause crm-hygiene job, requeue webhooks for that job's account list, and patch consumer to treat 409 as retryable.
Omar (Platform): 409 suggests a race between write and the webhook read model. Two possibilities: the write committed but read cache stale, or the dispatcher sent an empty body (seen above). I'll triage logs and the dispatcher config. If dispatcher is dropping payloads when queue depth spikes we need immediate throttling.
PlaybookBot: playbook-runner alert — owner-change queue depth spiked to 1.2k at 03:12 UTC, retry-fail rate +18% over 5m. Link: https://console.redwood/inbox/alerts/owner-queue-1719502468
Priya (CS Ops): action items: 1) Omar to check dispatcher throttles and surface root cause (owner-event-drop?). 2) Omar to run small requeue script: `./tools/requeue_webhooks --job crm-hygiene-2024-11-25-03 --only acct_8f3c,acct_9a1b,acct_3d2e` 3) CS (Jules/Ben) to claim the 3 affected trials manually and notify customers. 4) I'll open a follow-up RFC for making 409 retryable and adding an idempotent enqueue. ETA for hotfix?
Omar (Platform): ack. I'll pause the scheduled run immediately, run initial triage in next 20m, and post a short postmortem if we find a dispatcher bug.
Ben (CS Manager): please @me when requeue is done so we can nudge those accounts. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
